## Toddler Swimwear Sizes 2T–4T for Active Play

From 2T to 4T, toddlers crawl, sit and climb around in wet suits. We line the front and seat to cope with that friction, and a 3-snap crotch or a front or back entry zip makes changes and toilet trips at the pool quicker.

Choose the standard chart below or send your own before the first sample; we cut and grade to whichever sizing your labels carry.

| Size | Age | Height | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2T | About 2 years | 88 to 94 cm | 12 to 14 kg |
| 3T | About 3 years | 94 to 100 cm | 14 to 16 kg |
| 4T | About 4 years | 100 to 106 cm | 16 to 18 kg |

## Tween and Teen Swimwear Sizes and Shaped Fits

For tween and young teen styles that need room at the bust, waist and hips, choose a shaped teen fit instead of our proportional children's grading.

- **Sizes by age or height**: Order tween and young teen sizes by age, from 8-10 to 12-14, or by height up to 164 cm, the chart we recommend for European markets.
- **A separate teen block**: Each shaped style is drafted on its own teen block, allowing for a developing bust, a defined waist, fuller hips and a longer torso.
- **Graded area by area**: We grade the bust, waist and hips separately, so proportions, coverage, support and tension stay right from the smallest teen size to the largest.
- **Fit checked in movement**: As well as checking fit standing, we check every teen sample in movement, where riding up and gaping show.
- **Support for older sizes**: Sewn-in or removable foam padding and cup pockets suit teen tops and one-pieces, while underwire channels and moulded cups go only into the older sizes.

Can you make separate fits for toddlers in swim nappies and for toilet-trained toddlers?

Yes, we cut separate patterns. The swim-nappy fit adds 2 to 3 cm to the standard seat and rise and widens the leg openings, while the toilet-trained fit keeps the standard seat, rise and leg openings. We sample both for your approval before bulk, because a nappy layer added to a standard pattern changes the fit and the suit leaks or pulls.

Can you make tween and teen bikinis and tankinis with more coverage?

Yes. We make tankinis with more coverage, including cross-strap tops with swim shorts, as well as age-appropriate bikinis. Tops come high-neck or as sporty crops, and bottoms come full-coverage or mid-rise, or as swim shorts or skirted bottoms.
